title: Dead-letter and replay workflow for inference metric ingestion (Prometheus/OTel)
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Objective: Add a robust dead-letter and replay path to the inference metrics ingestion pipeline that receives Prometheus remote_write and OpenTelemetry metric batches. The pipeline must: classify failure reasons (schema mismatch, label explosion, rate-limit rejections, corrupt protobufs), persist failed batches with searchable metadata, provide an operator-driven replay tool that performs schema upgrades/transformations during replay, and include telemetry (counts, age, replay success) surfaced to the Console. Motivation: we've observed intermittent drops and silent metric loss during transient downstream failures and schema evolution. Without a DLQ/replay we cannot perform safe backfills or SLO-grounded reconciliation for customer KPIs.
acceptance_criteria: All malformed or temporarily-rejected metric batches are persisted to a DLQ store with original payload and failure_reason as an indexed tag
DLQ retention defaults to 14 days and is configurable per-tenant via the Console
A replay tool (CLI + internal API) can re-ingest DLQ entries idempotently into the main pipeline with per-tenant rate controls
Replayed metrics maintain original timestamps and attribute provenance (replay_id, original_ingest_time)
Pipeline exposes DLQ gauges and replay metrics to Prometheus and Console dashboards (DLQ_size, avg_age_hours, replay_success_rate)
Runbook created describing triage steps for top-3 failure reasons and emergency manual replay flow
implementation_steps: Instrument current ingest gateway to attach a structured failure_reason and raw_payload pointer on all non-OK pipeline errors
Design DLQ schema (S3+metadata index in DynamoDB) with per-tenant namespaces and search keys: failure_reason, ingest_time, tenant_id, sha256(payload)
Implement DLQ writer in ingest sidecar with backoff/resilience to avoid blocking primary path
Build replay API service that validates payload against newest schema, applies migration transforms, and forwards to normal ingestion with idempotency token
Add Console UI slice and API endpoints to browse DLQ entries, trigger dry-run validations, and schedule replays
Export DLQ and replay metrics to our telemetry fabric and add a default dashboard for SRE/Customer Success
Add e2e tests: malformed protobuf sample, label explosion synthetic, and simulated Prometheus remote_write 500 responses to exercise replay end-to-end
comments: 2026-02-20: Spike complete. Captured three canonical failure modes from logs: (1) invalid OTLP metric descriptor (schema drift), (2) tenant label cardinality explosion causing downstream storage OOM, (3) transient remote_write 502 from TSDB. — Aisha

2026-02-25: Design review with infra and storage teams. Agreed on S3+DDB index for DLQ because we need cheap large-object storage plus fast tag search. Luca to prototype writer. — Infra notes: store payload compressed and include SHA256 for dedupe.
2026-03-03: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/812 — initial DLQ writer and schema; awaiting review from @jamie and @sofia. Added unit tests for idempotency token handling. — Luca
2026-03-08: Product requested a per-tenant DLQ retention toggle in Console; logged UX task PM-4421. Also flagged customer_impact for two enterprise tenants who observed missing latency histograms.

2026-03-10: Security review note: payloads may contain PII in label values (rare). Decided to encrypt DLQ objects with customer KMS if tenant requests Private deployment. Security to sign off on encryption design next week. — Security: Raj Patel
